## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.20.3

### 🛡️ Detector Status
- Keeps the End-of-Life entity available for supported smoke, CO, and combination detectors.
- Shows the End-of-Life state as clear instead of unknown when X-Sense omits the field, matching the X-Sense app's status handling.

### 📷 Camera Images
- Refreshes the latest X-Sense event image before serving the Home Assistant camera image.
- Prefers the full event image over the smaller package crop or recording-list thumbnail.

### 💾 Recording Cache
- Confirms local cache deletion in the Recordings panel after storage statistics refresh.
- Prevents background synchronization from silently downloading a manually deleted cached recording again.
- Allows an explicitly selected recording to be fetched again on demand.
- Keeps the source recording visible when it still exists on the X-Sense SD card or cloud; local cleanup never deletes X-Sense recordings.

Please test detector End-of-Life status, camera image freshness and quality, and local recording-cache cleanup.
